Envoy Compliance Certifications
Envoy Compliance Certifications
We understand the impact that compliance requirements have on your business. Here's how we can help.
 May 1, 2026
Table of contents
At Envoy, we take the security and privacy of your data seriously. Envoy adheres to GDPR, CPRA, and other privacy and security regulations. We also have policies and controls to help you manage security threats, protect your data, and meet your compliance obligations. 
You can trust Envoy to help you meet high security standards and compliance requirements, including:
General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
Service Organization Controls (SOC 2)
International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)
FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)
Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act (GLBA)
Customs Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (CTPAT)
Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA)
To learn more about the standards we meet and how Envoy can help support your compliance efforts, please take a look at our compliance certifications page.
How to request the latest SOC 2 report from the Trust Center
The Envoy Trust Center is available for you to learn about our security posture and request access to our security documentation.
